process_mvs_synth_scene: process a MVS-Synth scene into WAI format by symlinking images, converting depth maps, and transforming camera poses
run_mvs_synth_conversion: run the MVS-Synth to WAI format conversion script using the argconf YAML configuration file
convert_depth_maps: convert MVS-Synth depth maps from EXR to metric scale by filtering sky values and dividing by 10
transform_camera_poses: transform MVS-Synth camera extrinsics from world-to-camera to camera-to-world and convert left-handed to right-handed coordinate system
generate_wai_scene_metadata: generate WAI scene metadata JSON with frame info, intrinsics, and camera model for a processed MVS-Synth scene
